reading.title: Getting Ready
reading.text: Every morning I get ready for school. First I take off my pyjamas and put on a clean shirt. Mum irons my shirt the night before. Then I put on my dark trousers. They are a bit tight, so Mum bought a new pair yesterday. They are baggy, and I like them. I button up my shirt and tuck it in. Then I eat breakfast.

listening.title: Shopping for Clothes
listening.script: Yesterday I went shopping with my dad. I needed a new shirt for my cousin's party. I tried a striped shirt, but it was too big. Then I tried a short-sleeved shirt, and it fitted well. Dad also bought a pair of grey trousers. At home I put them on, and they looked great. I will iron the shirt tomorrow.

reading.title: Grandma's Sweater
reading.text: My grandmother loves to knit. Last winter she knitted me a woollen sweater. It is blue with a white pattern. I pull it on every cold morning. My father wears a tie to work, and Grandma knitted a tie for him too. He tied it for the first time at our family dinner. Everybody laughed because it was too short. Now he wears it at home only.

listening.title: School Photo Day
listening.script: Today was school photo day. Our teacher said, "Wear your school tie and a clean sweater." I could not tie my tie, so my friend Bobur helped me. Then we tied our shoelaces and stood in line. It was hot in the hall, so I took off my sweater. The photographer said, "Smile!" and took the picture. I loosened my tie after that.

reading.title: A Snowy Day
reading.text: This morning it snowed a lot. I got dressed quickly and put on my winter coat. Mum gave me a woolly hat with a red pompom. "Do up your coat," she said. At school I hung up my coat and took off my hat. My friend Laylo wore a new dress and looked lovely. After school we made a snowman and gave it my old hat.

listening.script: On Saturday we went to my cousin's wedding. I wore a green dress and a small white hat. My brother put on a dark coat. The bride wore a long white wedding dress. reading.title: My School Uniform
reading.text: At my school, all children must wear a uniform. Mine is a dark blue jacket and grey trousers. We also have a badge with the name of the school. In the morning I put on my uniform quickly. After school I change out of it and hang it up. Mum takes the jackets to the cleaner's once a month. I like it because everybody looks smart and nobody argues about clothes.

listening.script: In our street there are many people in uniform. My neighbour is a nurse. She wears a white uniform with a small badge. Her husband is a policeman, and his uniform is dark blue. reading.text: This morning the weather was freezing. Mum said, "Wrap a scarf round your neck." I wore thick socks and put on my woollen gloves. But on the bus I lost one glove! My friend Rustam gave me one of his. We laughed because his glove was bigger and red. At school I took off the gloves and the scarf and put them on the radiator.

reading.title: New Shoes
reading.text: My old shoes were worn out, so Dad took me to the shoe shop. I tried on three pairs of shoes. The first pair was too tight, and the second pair was ugly. The third pair were white running shoes, and they fitted me perfectly. They were also very comfortable. I wore them home and did not take them off until bedtime. On Sunday Dad polished his shoes, but I only wiped mine.

listening.script: In my grandmother's house, everybody takes off their shoes at the door. There is a big shelf with many pairs of shoes. When I arrive, I take off my shoes and put on soft slippers.
